description: The NOAA GFS forecast frames MapMap publishes for drawing weather on a map: 17 frames (0 to 48 hours every 3 hours) of the newest run, each with URLs for the global rain, temperature, cloud, gust and sea-level pressure PNG fields (1440 by 721, value-encoded; decode with `encodings`), the wind field (PNG plus JSON ranges) and XYZ tile templates for rain, temperature and isobars. Optional `run` (YYYYMMDDHH) and `fields`. The URLs need the caller's own MapMap key. A FORECAST, not an observation, processed by MapMap from NOAA GFS 0.25 degree data (regridded and quantised): never describe it as original NOAA data or imply NOAA endorsement. `status` says whether the newest run is fresh. Requires the MapMap gateway. Display the returned `attribution`.

fields.description:
Which fields to return URLs for, any of `rain`, `temp`, `cloud`,
`gust`, `mslp`, `wind`, `isobars`. Default: all.

run.description:
A forecast run as YYYYMMDDHH (UTC), e.g. "2026101700". Default: the
newest run.

name: weather_frames

half.description: Half-resolution PNG URLs by field, when the run has them.

tiles.description: XYZ tile templates by field (`rain`, `temp`: PNG; `isobars`: MVT).

urls.description:
Absolute URLs by field (global value-encoded PNGs; wind also has a
JSON ranges file under `wind_json`). Each needs the caller's own
MapMap key.

valid_at.description: The time the frame is valid for (RFC 3339 UTC).

WeatherModelOut.description: The forecast model behind the frames.

horizon_h.description: Hours covered from the run time.

resolution_deg.description: Grid resolution of the source data, degrees.

age_s.description: Seconds since `generated_at` when the answer was assembled.

encodings.description:
How to decode each PNG field (unit, scale, offset), verbatim from
the manifest.

generated_at.description: When MapMap published the manifest (RFC 3339 UTC).

label.description: "Forecast, not an observation". Pass it on.

note.description:
Derived from NOAA GFS and modified by MapMap; no NOAA endorsement
is implied. Pass it on.

processed_by.description: "MapMap": the data is processed by MapMap.

status.description:
`ok`, `stale` (the newest run is older than the threshold) or
`unknown` (no frames). Pass a stale or unknown status on.

summary.description: One sentence for the answer. Pass it on with its qualifier.

threshold_s.description: The age in seconds after which the frames count as stale.
